id: \bMaybe the volcano? I hear they have good fire types there.
en: \bMaybe the volcano? I hear they have good fire types there.
it: \bO forse al vulcano? Ho sentito che lì ci sono buoni Pokémon di tipo Fuoco.

id: \rI said I needed a break so you battle me? Where do you come from to think that's okay?
en: \rI said I needed a break so you battle me? Where do you come from to think that's okay?
it: \rHo detto che mi serviva una pausa e tu mi sfidi? Ma da dove vieni per pensare che vada bene?

id: \rI need to get ready for Lush Jungle.
en: \rI need to get ready for Lush Jungle.

id: \rI guess I'm not as ready as I thought. Just a Meowth is hardly prepared.
en: \rI guess I'm not as ready as I thought. Just a Meowth is hardly prepared.
it: \rForse non sono pronta come pensavo. Un solo Meowth non basta proprio.

id: \bFossils are amazing. To think we can bring dead Pokémon back to life.
en: \bFossils are amazing. To think we can bring dead Pokémon back to life.
it: \bI fossili sono incredibili. Pensare che possiamo riportare in vita Pokémon estinti.

id: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
en: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
it: \bGran bella lotta. Buona fortuna con il resto.

id: \rMaybe I should get a second one.
en: \rMaybe I should get a second one.

id: \bI didn't lose. Not in spirit at least.
en: \bI didn't lose. Not in spirit at least.
it: \bNon ho perso. Almeno non nello spirito.
